description: Org invite link keys (docs/enterprise-accounts.md §7). offerKey = HKDF-SHA256(ikm=linkKey, salt=empty, info='flagship/org-invite-offer/v1', 32); the invite key's hybrid secret (Ed25519 seed || ML-DSA-65 seed) = HKDF-SHA256(ikm=linkKey, salt=empty, info='flagship/org-invite-key/v1', 64). reads: verifyOrgInviteRead(invites[invite], issuedAt, signature, now) == expect (±5 min). accepts: verifyOrgInviteAccept(invites[invite], acceptObjects[accept], signature) == expect. Signatures are hybrid Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65, deterministic.

reads.name: a fresh proof by the invite key
at the edge of the 5-minute window
a proof for this seat replayed on another seat
from the future: more than 5 minutes ahead

accepts.name: the accept signed by the invite key
signed by the member key only
this seat's proof on another seat's accept
another seat's accept against this invite
the accept changed after signing (another member key)
